Definition: from G4253 and G3309; to care (anxiously) in advance:--take thought beforehand.
BiblicalUsage: Promerimnao means to care anxiously in advance, to take thought beforehand. Jesus uses it once: when they shall lead you and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that anxiety beforehand is a burden I am told to lay down, because the Spirit speaks in the hour.
